### Key Findings
* **Thinking-Pause Trap ([Endpoint Docs](https://docs.example.com/voice/endpoint-detection)):** Mid-sentence pauses run **600–900 ms**; tight VAD (<500 ms) cuts developers off.
* **Code ASR Errors ([ArXiv Study](https://arxiv.example.org/html/2601.15339v1)):** Baseline WER exceeds **40–60%** (`"async"` → `"a sink"`), improved **20.95% WER** via LLM cleanup.
* **Mobile Walk-Away ([Field Notes, 2026](https://notes.example.org/2026/01/02/mobile-agents/)):** Overlay VPN + Mosh + `tmux` per git worktree.

Over Bluetooth, you reliably have **three discrete triggers** (**Single tap**, **Double tap / `NEXT`**, and **Triple tap / `PREVIOUS`**)—**not** press-and-hold or volume buttons.

| Bluetooth Input | Reaches App? | Reliability & Quirk |
|---|---|---|
| Single tap (`PLAY` `0x44`, `PAUSE` `0x46`, `PLAY_PAUSE`, `HEADSETHOOK`) | Yes | Universal. AVRCP has no `PLAY_PAUSE` opcode—headsets alternate `PLAY` and `PAUSE`. |
| Double tap / `NEXT` (`KEYCODE_MEDIA_NEXT` `0x4B`) | Yes | Near-universal. Default `MediaSession` doesn't synthesize double-tap from `PLAY`/`PAUSE`, so `onMediaButtonEvent` must count rapid taps itself. |
| Triple tap / `PREVIOUS` (`KEYCODE_MEDIA_PREVIOUS` `0x4C`) | Yes | Common on earbuds; absent on bare 1-button earpieces. |
| Long-press / Hold-to-Talk | No | AVRCP never generates `FLAG_LONG_PRESS`. Earbud holds trigger ANC or HFP `AT+BVRA=1` (OS Assistant). |
| Headset Volume `+` / `-` | No | Handled internally by AVRCP Absolute Volume / HFP `AT+VGS`. |

Side note: setting `ROLE_ASSISTANT` is the only way headset hold reaches a custom app, which replaces the system assistant globally.

That locks down the full UX spec—adding **automatic TTS readback of the organized draft** on Pause & Stage and **durable per-session draft persistence**.

| State | 1x Tap | 2x Tap or NEXT | 3x Tap, PREV, or X | Studio Earcon |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ARMED_IDLE` | Start Recording | Read aloud last reply | Disarm (UI / STOP) | `toggle-on.ogg` |
| `RECORDING` | Stop -> 2.5s Send Grace | Pause, Organize & Readback -> `STAGED_DRAFT` | Discard burst | `start.ogg` |
| `SEND_GRACE` (2.5s) | Undo -> `STAGED_DRAFT` | Undo -> `STAGED_DRAFT` | Discard | `queued.ogg` -> `send.ogg` |
| `STAGED_DRAFT` | Append new burst | Commit & Send | Discard draft | `pause.ogg` + TTS |
